# Prenton Realty — Full-Service Real Estate Brokerage (Chicago, Naperville, Los Cabos)

> Boutique, full-service real estate brokerage based in Naperville, Illinois with 25+ years of experience and $400M+ in closed volume. Commercial, residential, international (Los Cabos), and a dedicated Capital Markets practice for private equity firms, family offices, syndications, and investment groups pooling capital. Contact: Edward Sanchez, (630) 219-0352, edward@prentonrealty.com.

## Capital Markets & Investment Group Advisory (https://prentonrealty.com/capital-markets/)

- Serves: private equity firms and sponsors, family offices, syndications, investment clubs, 1031 investors, and any group pooling money to purchase real estate assets
- Services: acquisition sourcing (incl. off-market/NDA deal flow), institutional-grade underwriting and financial modeling (IRR, equity multiples, debt scenarios), investment sales and dispositions, debt/refinancing coordination, 1031 exchange strategy, portfolio strategy
- Led by Edward Sanchez: DePaul Finance, with capital markets experience at both Fitch Ratings and Great Wolf Lodge (a Blackstone portfolio company), supporting a $2.55B refinancing
- Success-based brokerage compensation in most mandates; commissions set by agreement and fully negotiable
